description: This file contains helper functions to query the Prometheus API, including retrieving metrics, fallback metrics, checking connection status, and fetching daily spend data.

methods.name: get_metric_from_prometheus
methods.description: Fetches a specific metric from Prometheus for the last 24 hours.

methods.name: get_fallback_metric_from_prometheus
methods.description: Retrieves fallback metrics related to deployment success and failure from Prometheus for the last 24 hours.

methods.name: is_prometheus_connected
methods.description: Checks if the Prometheus URL is configured, indicating a connection.

methods.name: get_daily_spend_from_prometheus
methods.description: Fetches daily spend data over the last 30 days from Prometheus, optionally filtered by an API key.
